developers.name: Developers Library
developers.metaTitle: Developers Library: free open-licensed resources | Oyekola Julius
developers.metaDescription: Free, open-licensed books, specifications and docs for web developers, each with its license, author and a ready-to-copy citation.
developers.lead: Books, specifications and documentation I rely on, all free to read and openly licensed. Every entry names its author, shows its license, and comes with a citation you can copy.

designers.name: Designers Library
designers.metaTitle: Designers Library: free open-licensed resources | Oyekola Julius
designers.metaDescription: Free, open-licensed standards, icons, illustrations and design tools, each with its license, author and a ready-to-copy citation.
designers.lead: Standards, icons, illustrations and tools for designers, all openly licensed. Every entry names its author, shows its license, and comes with a citation you can copy.

resources.title: MDN Web Docs
resources.author: MDN contributors (Mozilla)
resources.summary: The reference I reach for first: clear documentation for HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the web platform APIs, maintained by Mozilla and an open community.

resources.title: HTML Living Standard
resources.author: WHATWG
resources.summary: The authoritative, continuously updated specification for HTML. Dense, but it settles every argument about what a tag is actually supposed to do.

resources.title: Pro Git
resources.author: Scott Chacon & Ben Straub
resources.summary: The standard free book on Git, from first commit to internals. Read online or download an edition from the official site.

resources.title: Eloquent JavaScript
resources.author: Marijn Haverbeke
resources.summary: A modern introduction to JavaScript and programming in general, with exercises you can run in the browser.

resources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
resources.author: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
resources.summary: The international standard for accessible web content. The success criteria I check my own designs against, from contrast to focus order.

resources.title: Lucide Icons
resources.author: Lucide Contributors

license.name: ISC
license.note: Portions derived from Feather are MIT licensed.

resources.summary: A clean, consistent open-source icon set with simple SVGs that drop into any project, free for personal and commercial use.

resources.title: Open Peeps
resources.author: Pablo Stanley
resources.summary: A hand-drawn illustration library for mixing and matching characters. Public domain, so you can use it without attribution.

resources.title: Penpot
resources.author: Kaleidos and contributors
resources.summary: An open-source design and prototyping tool that runs in the browser, built around open web standards like SVG and CSS.
